run_mcc_training: run the MCC model training loop on CO3D or Hypersim datasets with configurable epochs and batch size
run_mcc_viz: run visualization inference on a trained MCC model using the --run_viz flag
build_mcc_args_parser: build an argparse parser with all MCC training, model, and data configuration arguments
build_mcc_data_loader: build a distributed PyTorch data loader for CO3D or Hypersim datasets with configurable batch size
run_mcc_eval: run evaluation of the MCC model on the validation set every 5 epochs during training
